==Trivia==
* The best relic for him is his signature weapon, [[Relics|Mirrorblade]], as it not only benefits his critical rate capability but also every time Lostvain triggers, he deals even more damage due to the exeeding crit rate output. If you don't have it, his other choices are the [[Relics|Nail]] Relic because it boosts crit damage by 15-30% and other stats, or [[Relics|The 5-Leaf Clover]] because it not only boosts his Physical and Dark damage, but also if there's any mobs with Magic resistance on, he can take full advantage of the situation.
* There was a bug when this unit came out causing multiple people to get unique on him with a single spin. shit crazy unfair
